description.value: J, N & Z Deli is Vancouver's oldest Eastern European deli, family-owned and operated by the Jeremic family since 1987. Located on the iconic Commercial Drive, it specializes in traditional Serbian-style smoked meats, cured sausages, and hand-crafted pork products made using old-school techniques with natural ingredients. A stop here offers touring cyclists access to high-quality, protein-dense provisions from a genuine neighbourhood landmark with over three decades of community history.
